reviewNotes: HOLD. Current binding PAYG terms use a four-month/120-day inactivity clock and 365-day unused-credit expiry, while the current iD marketing page and a provider employee community answer describe 180-day activity. Preserve the first-party conflict and use the stricter legal 120-day clock operationally until iD harmonizes the wording. Minimum top-up is not promoted as a provider-verified fact.

events.outcome: Current PAYG legal terms permit disconnection after four months without credit, a bundle or a chargeable event and expire unused credit after 365 days without an additional top-up. Current iD marketing/community wording also says 180 days, so the conflict is preserved rather than silently choosing the looser interval.

data.acquisitionSummary: Current iD PAYG is sold as one-off 30-day plans and supports physical SIM or eSIM. After a plan expires, PAYG credit can be used at 3p/min, 2p/text and 1p/MB.

keep.action: Current legal terms allow disconnection after four months without applying credit, buying a bundle or making a chargeable event; unused credit expires after 365 days unless an additional top-up is made. A 2p text is a chargeable event while usable credit remains, but the minimum top-up amount is not treated as provider-verified here.

data.chinaActivation: Physical SIM is delivered to UK addresses; eSIM QR is emailed. China-first eSIM use/activation and overseas-only retention are not established.
data.kyc: Current PAYG product states no credit check; additional identity requirements for all acquisition paths are not established here.
data.payment: Top-up is available in the iD app/account; minimum top-up and foreign-card acceptance are not established by current provider pages used here.
data.refund: Credit and allowances are non-refundable under current PAYG terms.
data.holdReason: Current iD PAYG legal terms use a 120-day/four-month inactivity clock, while current iD marketing and an employee community answer say 180 days. Use the stricter 120-day clock until the provider resolves the conflict.
data.tariffSummary: Current PAYG: plans from £6/30d; standard post-plan rates 3p/min, 2p/text, 1p/MB; legal terms use 120-day inactivity and 365-day credit expiry.
guideSteps: Choose physical SIM or eSIM and activate the PAYG line.
Use the stricter 120-day chargeable-activity clock from the current legal terms while the 180-day provider copy remains unresolved.
Track the separate 365-day unused-credit expiry and top up before that deadline if retaining credit.
